    # Extract the canonical permutation from the GSL structure

    return canonical_permutation

    gslcblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)

    nbins = int(xmax - xmin) + 1
    hist = gsl.histogram_alloc(nbins)
    for i in range(len(data)):

    # Compute the histogram
    gsl.histogram_compute(hist, xmin, xmax)

    # Allocate memory for the output list of tuples
    out = []
    for i in range(nbins):

        upper_bound = lower_bound + gsl.histogram_get_width(hist, i)
        count = gsl.histogram_get_count(hist, i)
        out.append((lower_bound, upper_bound, count))

    # Free the histogram memory
    gsl.histogram_free(hist)

    return out
